title: deliverables/<id>.md header
description: A deliverable's header. The JSON object between the --- lines only; the body is outside this schema. The body is its composition template.

label.description: The display name of the deliverable; never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the deliverable).

format.description: The composed output's format by name: markdown_block, plaintext or an object format; markdown_inline is refused.

if.description: A JSON Logic condition for whether the deliverable exists, or null for always.

check.description: The check that gates release, written check.<id>, or null for ungated.

whenEmpty.description: What happens when the composed text is empty.
